versos.hebraico: נָ֣סוּ וְאֵין־רֹדֵ֣ף רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝צַדִּיקִ֗ים כִּכְפִ֥יר יִבְטָֽח׃

controles.web: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.
controles.kjv: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.
controles.livre: Os perversos fogem mesmo quando não há quem os persiga, mas os justos são confiantes como um leão.

versos.hebraico: בְּפֶ֣שַֽׁע אֶ֭רֶץ רַבִּ֣ים שָׂרֶ֑יהָ וּבְאָדָ֥ם מֵבִ֥ין יֹ֝דֵ֗עַ כֵּ֣ן יַאֲרִֽיךְ׃

controles.web: In rebellion, a land has many rulers, but order is maintained by a man of understanding and knowledge.
controles.kjv: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged.
controles.livre: Pela rebelião numa terra, seus governantes são muitos; mas por meio de um homem prudente e conhecedor seu governo permanecerá.

versos.hebraico: גֶּ֣בֶר רָ֭שׁ וְעֹשֵׁ֣ק דַּלִּ֑ים מָטָ֥ר סֹ֝חֵ֗ף וְאֵ֣ין לָֽחֶם׃

controles.web: A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops.
controles.kjv: A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.
controles.livre: O homem pobre que oprime aos necessitados é como uma chuva devastadora que causa falta de pão.

versos.hebraico: עֹזְבֵ֣י ת֭וֹרָה יְהַֽלְל֣וּ רָשָׁ֑ע וְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י ת֝וֹרָ֗ה יִתְגָּ֥רוּ בָֽם׃פ

controles.web: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them.
controles.kjv: They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.
controles.livre: Os que abandonam a lei louvam ao perverso; porém os que guardam a lei lutarão contra eles.

versos.hebraico: אַנְשֵׁי־רָ֭ע לֹא־יָבִ֣ינוּ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּמְבַקְשֵׁ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה יָבִ֥ינוּ כֹֽל׃

controles.web: Evil men don’t understand justice; but those who seek Yahweh understand it fully.
controles.kjv: Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the Lord understand all things.
controles.livre: Os homens maus não entendem a justiça; mas os que buscam ao SENHOR entendem tudo.

versos.hebraico: טֽוֹב־רָ֭שׁ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בְּתֻמּ֑וֹ מֵעִקֵּ֥שׁ דְּ֝רָכַ֗יִם וְה֣וּא עָשִֽׁיר׃

controles.web: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity, than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.
controles.kjv: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.
controles.livre: Melhor é o pobre que anda em sua honestidade do que o perverso de caminhos, ainda que seja rico.

versos.hebraico: נוֹצֵ֣ר תּ֭וֹרָה בֵּ֣ן מֵבִ֑ין וְרֹעֶה זֽ֝וֹלְלִ֗ים יַכְלִ֥ים אָבִֽיו׃

controles.web: Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father.
controles.kjv: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.
controles.livre: O que guarda a lei é um filho prudente, mas o companheiro de comilões envergonha a seu pai.

versos.hebraico: מַרְבֶּ֣ה ה֭וֹנוֹ בְּנֶ֣שֶׁךְ ובתרבית לְחוֹנֵ֖ן דַּלִּ֣ים יִקְבְּצֶֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.
controles.kjv: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.
controles.livre: Aquele que aumenta seus bens por meio de juros e lucros desonestos está juntando para o que se compadece dos pobres.

versos.hebraico: מֵסִ֣יר אָ֭זְנוֹ מִשְּׁמֹ֣עַ תּוֹרָ֑ה גַּֽם־תְּ֝פִלָּת֗וֹ תּוֹעֵבָֽה׃

controles.web: He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.
controles.kjv: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.
controles.livre: Aquele que desvia seus ouvidos de ouvir a lei, até sua oração será abominável.

versos.hebraico: מַשְׁגֶּ֤ה יְשָׁרִ֨ים׀ בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ רָ֗ע בִּשְׁחוּת֥וֹ הֽוּא־יִפּ֑וֹל וּ֝תְמִימִ֗ים יִנְחֲלוּ־טֽוֹב׃

controles.web: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own trap; but the blameless will inherit good.
controles.kjv: Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.
controles.livre: Aquele que faz as pessoas corretas errarem em direção a um mau caminho, ele mesmo cairá em sua cova; mas os que não tiverem pecado herdarão o bem.

versos.hebraico: חָכָ֣ם בְּ֭עֵינָיו אִ֣ישׁ עָשִׁ֑יר וְדַ֖ל מֵבִ֣ין יַחְקְרֶֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.
controles.kjv: The rich man is wise in his own conceit; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.
controles.livre: O homem rico é sábio aos seus próprios olhos; mas o pobre prudente o examina.

versos.hebraico: בַּעֲלֹ֣ץ צַ֭דִּיקִים רַבָּ֣ה תִפְאָ֑רֶת וּבְק֥וּם רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְחֻפַּ֥שׂ אָדָֽם׃

controles.web: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.
controles.kjv: When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.
controles.livre: Quando os justos estão contentes, muita é a alegria; mas quando os perversos se levantam, os homens se escondem.

versos.hebraico: מְכַסֶּ֣ה פְ֭שָׁעָיו לֹ֣א יַצְלִ֑יחַ וּמוֹדֶ֖ה וְעֹזֵ֣ב יְרֻחָֽם׃

controles.web: He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
controles.kjv: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.
controles.livre: Quem encobre suas transgressões nunca prosperará, mas aquele que as confessa e as abandona alcançará misericórdia.

versos.hebraico: אַשְׁרֵ֣י אָ֭דָם מְפַחֵ֣ד תָּמִ֑יד וּמַקְשֶׁ֥ה לִ֝בּ֗וֹ יִפּ֥וֹל בְּרָעָֽה׃

controles.web: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.
controles.kjv: Happy is the man that feareth alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.
controles.livre: Bem-aventurado o homem que sempre mantém seu temor; mas aquele que endurece seu coração cairá no mal.

versos.hebraico: אֲרִי־נֹ֭הֵם וְדֹ֣ב שׁוֹקֵ֑ק מֹשֵׁ֥ל רָ֝שָׁ֗ע עַ֣ל עַם־דָּֽל׃

controles.web: As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.
controles.kjv: As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.
controles.livre: Leão rugidor e urso faminto é o governante perverso sobre um povo pobre.

versos.hebraico: נָגִ֗יד חֲסַ֣ר תְּ֭בוּנוֹת וְרַ֥ב מַעֲשַׁקּ֑וֹת שנאי בֶ֝֗צַע יַאֲרִ֥יךְ יָמִֽים׃פ

controles.web: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.
controles.kjv: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.
controles.livre: O príncipe que tem falta de entendimento aumenta as opressões; mas aquele que odeia o lucro desonesto prolongará seus dias.

versos.hebraico: אָ֭דָם עָשֻׁ֣ק בְּדַם־נָפֶשׁ עַד־בּ֥וֹר יָ֝נ֗וּס אַל־יִתְמְכוּ־בֽוֹ׃

controles.web: A man who is tormented by life blood will be a fugitive until death; no one will support him.
controles.kjv: A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.
controles.livre: O homem atormentado pelo sangue de alguma alma fugirá até a cova; ninguém o detenha.

versos.hebraico: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ תָּ֭מִים יִוָּשֵׁ֑עַ וְנֶעְקַ֥שׁ דְּ֝רָכַ֗יִם יִפּ֥וֹל בְּאֶחָֽת׃

controles.web: Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.
controles.kjv: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.
controles.livre: Aquele que anda sinceramente será salvo; mas o que se desvia em seus caminhos cairá de uma só vez.

versos.hebraico: עֹבֵ֣ד אַ֭דְמָתוֹ יִֽשְׂבַּֽע־לָ֑חֶם וּמְרַדֵּ֥ף רֵ֝קִ֗ים יִֽשְׂבַּֽע־רִֽישׁ׃

controles.web: One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.
controles.kjv: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.
controles.livre: Aquele que lavrar sua terra terá fartura de pão; mas o que segue coisas inúteis terá fartura de pobreza.

versos.hebraico: אִ֣ישׁ אֱ֭מוּנוֹת רַב־בְּרָכ֑וֹת וְאָ֥ץ לְ֝הַעֲשִׁ֗יר לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה׃

controles.web: A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.
controles.kjv: A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.
controles.livre: O homem fiel terá muitas bênçãos; mas o que se apressa para enriquecer não ficará impune.

versos.hebraico: הַֽכֵּר־פָּנִ֥ים לֹא־ט֑וֹב וְעַל־פַּת־לֶ֝֗חֶם יִפְשַׁע־גָּֽבֶר׃

controles.web: To show partiality is not good; yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.
controles.kjv: To have respect of persons is not good: for for a piece of bread that man will transgress.
controles.livre: Fazer acepção de pessoas não é bom; porque até por um pedaço de pão o homem pode transgredir.

versos.hebraico: נִֽבֳהָ֥ל לַה֗וֹן אִ֭ישׁ רַ֣ע עָ֑יִן וְלֹֽא־יֵ֝דַע כִּי־חֶ֥סֶר יְבֹאֶֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.
controles.kjv: He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.
controles.livre: Quem tem pressa para ter riquezas é um homem de olho mau; e ele não sabe que a miséria virá sobre ele.

versos.hebraico: מ֘וֹכִ֤יחַ אָדָ֣ם אַ֭חֲרַי חֵ֣ן יִמְצָ֑א מִֽמַּחֲלִ֥יק לָשֽׁוֹן׃

controles.web: One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.
controles.kjv: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.
controles.livre: Aquele que repreende ao homem obterá mais favor depois do que aquele que lisonjeia com a língua.

versos.hebraico: גּוֹזֵ֤ל׀ אָ֘בִ֤יו וְאִמּ֗וֹ וְאֹמֵ֥ר אֵֽין־פָּ֑שַׁע חָבֵ֥ר ה֝֗וּא לְאִ֣ישׁ מַשְׁחִֽית׃

controles.web: Whoever robs his father or his mother, and says, “It’s not wrong.” He is a partner with a destroyer.
controles.kjv: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith, It is no transgression; the same is the companion of a destroyer.
controles.livre: Aquele que furta seu pai ou sua mãe e diz: Não é pecado,É companheiro do homem destruidor.

versos.hebraico: רְחַב־נֶ֭פֶשׁ יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן וּבוֹטֵ֖חַ עַל־יְהוָ֣ה יְדֻשָּֽׁן׃

controles.web: One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in Yahweh will prosper.
controles.kjv: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that putteth his trust in the Lord shall be made fat.
controles.livre: Quem tem alma orgulhosa levanta brigas; mas aquele que confia no SENHOR prosperará.

versos.hebraico: בּוֹטֵ֣חַ בְּ֭לִבּוֹ ה֣וּא כְסִ֑יל וְהוֹלֵ֥ךְ בְּ֝חָכְמָ֗ה ה֣וּא יִמָּלֵֽט׃

controles.web: One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.
controles.kjv: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.
controles.livre: Aquele que confia em seu próprio coração é tolo; mas o que anda em sabedoria escapará em segurança .

versos.hebraico: נוֹתֵ֣ן לָ֭רָשׁ אֵ֣ין מַחְס֑וֹר וּמַעְלִ֥ים עֵ֝ינָ֗יו רַב־מְאֵרֽוֹת׃

controles.web: One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses.
controles.kjv: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.
controles.livre: Quem dá ao pobre não terá falta; mas o que esconde seus olhos terá muitas maldições.

versos.hebraico: בְּק֣וּם רְ֭שָׁעִים יִסָּתֵ֣ר אָדָ֑ם וּ֝בְאָבְדָ֗ם יִרְבּ֥וּ צַדִּיקִֽים׃

controles.web: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous thrive.
controles.kjv: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.
controles.livre: Quando os perversos ganham poder, os homens se escondem; mas quando perecem, os justos se multiplicam.
